text: The extent to which prenatal care is equity-oriented significantly influences patient satisfaction, care-seeking decisions, and health outcomes for both parent and newborn. The social determinants of health shape care experiences, disproportionately affecting marginalized populations (e.g., low-income, rural, racial minorities). This study explores prenatal patients’ care experiences and examines the impact of health inequities on these experiences.
source_label: Exploring prenatal care experiences in Ontario, Canada: An equity-oriented qualitative study
